## Overview

Audit and consolidate overlapping documentation across `docs/`, `.github/`, and `instructions/` to reduce duplication and improve maintainability.

## In-Scope

- Identify duplicate and conflicting guidance across issue, PR, labelling, and automation docs
- Define canonical source files and cross-link strategy
- Propose archive/migration targets for obsolete docs
- Update index and discoverability paths

## Out-of-Scope

- Rewriting all documentation in this issue
- Refactors unrelated to documentation location and quality

## Current Problems

1. Multiple files cover the same topics with divergence.
2. Cross-references are inconsistent.
3. Canonical placement is unclear in some areas.
4. Index completeness and navigation quality are uneven.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Duplication map completed
- [ ] Consolidation strategy defined by topic
- [ ] Archive/migration candidates identified
- [ ] Cross-reference/linking strategy documented

## Deliverables

- Consolidation matrix
- Canonical doc map
- Archive candidate list
- Follow-up implementation tasks
